shots.narration: The grain is here. The man who is supposed to receive it is not.
shots.prompt: Image 1 is the exact grain quay master, image 2 brick-red goods carrier, image 3 ochre grain-handling companion. Same camera, medium-wide composition with two workers waiting beside EXACTLY THREE closed pale woven grain sacks on the dry bank: one nearest the storehouse door, two nearer the water. Both look toward the empty part-open storehouse doorway, which has no receiver in it yet. The brick-red carrier holds the end of ONE loose carrying rope threaded around the nearest sack; ochre companion stands beside that sack with their hands down. Worker exact brick-red tunic, blue sash and charcoal lower; companion exact ochre slit-neck tunic, olive belt, charcoal trousers and dark closed footwear. Keep river LEFT, original boat and its mooring posts/ropes, mudbrick wall, reed shade, part-open door and TWO clay jars inside unchanged. No distant ziggurat, monumental skyline or Hanging Gardens. Sober BD crisp dark outlines, matte flat colours, limited texture and simple garment shadows. Both adult heads oversized perfect #FFFFFF circles, dot eyes, straight tiny mouths, no hair, beard, nose, ears or brows. ALL skin #FFFFFF without shading, mitten hands and covered bodies. No labels, text or children.
